mathematics.assertion_tested: Twelve exact symbolic identities for the spherically symmetric Abelian Yukawa exterior with fixed core/wall Higgs values and unit magnetic flux, including the on-shell action, massless limit, magnetic inverse-radius tail, and conditional BPS-core first-order matching. Three 60-digit action quadratures verify finite positive-mass examples.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact elementary functions over positive real symbolic variables; 60-digit mpmath finite quadratures.
mathematics.conventions: S_ext=4*pi*integral_rc^R r^2[kappa/2*(psi'^2+B^2)+kappa*m^2/2*psi^2]dr, B=1/r^2, psi(rc)=psi0, psi(R)=0, 0<rc<R, m>0, kappa>0. Conditional core matching uses v^-1<<rc<<m^-1 and q_core=v_core-1/r, psi_outer=-exp(-m*r)/r.
inputs: The explicitly defined linear Abelian exterior model
For deformed Yang-Mills application only: kappa=L/g^2, m^2=V_eff''(pi*T)/kappa, T=1/L; this identification is conditional on omitted matching terms being subleading
non_claims: Not a full deformed monopole saddle or determinant
Does not compute cosmological vacuum stress
No full QCD or electromagnetic matching
